messages:
maria_p: Quick heads-up — EU gov pilot wants a certified connector for Snowflake + our Milvus adapter. They require FIPS attestation, KMS integration, and proof of data residency. Need a quick ops + legal checklist.

ajay_pm: Can we reuse parts of the Delta Share certification playbook? If so that cuts the timeline. cc @kate_legal

sylvie_se: I can own the connector e2e tests and manifest. Need a stable sample dataset and acceptance criteria (latency / accuracy).

gunnar_eng: For FIPS/KMS we need gov-region VMs + HSM or cloud KMS pairing. Infra will need an explicit network isolation ticket. tagging infra-bot to start provisioning.

infra-bot: Provision request queued: PR-4721. Requested: gov-eu VPC, FIPS-enabled nodes x2, HSM tunnel. ETA initial: 3 business days. :gear:

kate_legal: Legal notes: we need a DPA addendum, export-control check, and EU SCCs signed. Also vendor questionnaire for encryption + key custody. I can draft the language but need a point of contact for the partner SI (name + org).

sam_fe: I'll draft the marketplace listing skeleton and grab screenshots from the staging connector. Also will add a short "gov compliance" section once Kate gives copy.

maria_p: Nice. Quick operational checklist (draft):
```
- [ ] infra: provision gov-region VPC + FIPS nodes + HSM (PR-4721)
- [ ] eng: connector e2e tests + perf run (10k rows, 500 qps)
- [ ] eng: manifest & compatibility matrix (Snowflake, Databricks, Milvus)
- [ ] legal: DPA addendum + SCCs + vendor questionnaire
- [ ] docs: marketplace listing + screenshots + install guide for gov networks
- [ ] field: SI handoff + partner runbook for on-prem installs
```

ajay_pm: Proposed timeline: infra 3d, eng 5d, legal 4d, docs 2d. If parallel that's ~7 business days to a dry-run. Is that acceptable to partner?

sylvie_se: Parallel works if infra gives access by EOD Thursday. I'll start writing tests and mock manifests in the meantime.

gunnar_eng: FYI, we'll need a small kernel tweak for FIPS mode — low risk but adds a 1-day validation. Marking in the ticket.

kate_legal: Send me the partner SI contact and their legal rep. I can have a DPA draft by Friday if I get details today.

sam_fe: Link to staging checklist: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1GovPilotChecklist (internal). I'll add a column for marketplace copy.

maria_p: Great — call to action: @gunnar_eng start infra ticket work, @sylvie_se start test harness, @kate_legal start DPA draft, @sam_fe prepare listing draft. Let's sync 10am PT tomorrow (30m). :calendar:

ajay_pm: +1, I'll invite the partner reps and SI lead.

maria_p: Thanks all — will post a status update in this thread after the sync. :thumbsup:
